events.title: Lehigh Valley Phantoms vs. Providence Bruins
events.blurb: AHL hockey downtown on Saturday night as the Phantoms host the Providence Bruins.
events.blurbEs: Hockey de la AHL en el centro el sábado por la noche: los Phantoms reciben a los Providence Bruins.

events.title: Christkindlmarkt Bethlehem
events.blurb: The German-style Christmas market at SteelStacks, 15 minutes from Allentown. Admission is free Friday 5–8 p.m. and for kids 5 and under; it's cashless and no pets except service dogs.
events.blurbEs: El mercado navideño de estilo alemán en SteelStacks, a 15 minutos de Allentown. La entrada es gratis el viernes de 5 a 8 p.m. y para niños de 5 años o menos; no se acepta efectivo ni mascotas, salvo perros de servicio.

events.title: Easton Winter Village & Peace Candle Lighting
events.blurb: Holiday vendor huts open for the season in downtown Easton on Friday, and the town lights its giant Peace Candle on Saturday evening.
events.blurbEs: Las casetas navideñas abren la temporada en el centro de Easton el viernes, y la ciudad enciende su gigantesca Peace Candle el sábado por la noche.

events.title: Winter Light Spectacular
events.blurb: A walk-through holiday light show at the zoo, with Elsa appearing nightly and Anna joining on Saturdays. The barnyard stays open until 8 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido a pie entre luces navideñas en el zoológico, con Elsa todas las noches y Anna los sábados. La granja abre hasta las 8 p.m.
events.getThere: Mill Creek Rd. is closed for construction through Nov. 30; follow the zoo's posted detour.

events.title: Allentown Art Museum
events.blurb: Downtown’s art museum is free for everyone and open Friday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. Free parking in the lot at Fifth and Linden streets.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte del centro es gratis para todos y abre de viernes a domingo, de 11 a.m. a 4 p.m. Estacionamiento gratis en el lote de las calles Fifth y Linden.
